shouldFix.charge: The D-056 role reads, verbatim: 'SATISFIED eligibility remains D-056 five gates. anti-lockstep leftover-join.v5 is not a SATISFIED-GRADE cycle. Adding a required-now gate without naming it in the same act flips condition 4. anti-lockstep leftover-join.v4 adds no gate.' The speaker flips from v5 to v4 inside a single role string. The final clause is the condition-4 protection clause for this custody pin, and in the subject it is spoken about the frozen predecessor rather than by the speaker. Every one of the other twelve v4 tokens in the subject is a legitimate object or custody reference ('remasures v4', 'Frozen v4 stays unmoved and unrecorded', 'Do not record v4 as current'); this is the sole site where v4 is the grammatical subject of a speaker-voiced disclaimer, which identifies it as a missed rename rather than an intended statement about the predecessor.

shouldFix.charge: The honesty obligation reads: 'CLAUDE-D300-A-1 called the locative leftover-design of OBL-G21-FX-AUTHORING remaining on g21 leftover-join.v14 / DR-G21 loose; leftover-design of OBL-G21-FX-AUTHORING remains on g21 leftover-join.v14 / DR-G21, and leftover-design of doctor-actor leftovers remains on DR-114.' Read on its face, that names as loose the exact directional form the advisory endorsed and the form the subject itself adopts and then restates in the very next clause. The advisory's recorded bytes say the opposite: its title is "The inherited clause 'G21 leftover remaining on DR-114' is locationally loose", and its measurement states that reading the clause strictly places the G21 leftover on DR-114 whereas OBL-G21-FX-AUTHORING is the leftover-design on the g21 leftover-join carrying registerRow DR-G21. The sentence is therefore self-cancelling: it calls loose the phrase it immediately asserts as correct.

decision: REJECT - 0 MUST-FIX, 2 SHOULD-FIX (ALJ-V5-SF1, ALJ-V5-SF2). All eight dispatch attacks are refuted: ALJ-V4-SF1's two required repairs are both present, all eight D-300 traveling advisories are carried without discharge, OBL-G21-FX-AUTHORING sits on g21 leftover-join.v14 / DR-G21 with doctor-actor leftovers left on DR-114, OBL-HOSTILE-GOLDENS stays leftover-design, there is no deictic speaker, proposedLaterWork[0] targets v5, nothing is SATISFIED, and all 30 structured digests plus 33 recordedInputs entries match live bytes. Two defects survive. The v4-to-v5 speaker rename missed the final clause of basedOn.d056.role, leaving the speaker's condition-4 no-gate disclaimer spoken about the frozen predecessor. And the honesty carrier that lands ALJ-V4-SF1 says CLAUDE-D300-A-1 called loose the very directional form that advisory endorsed and that the subject adopts, contradicting the advisory's recorded bytes. Both repairs are additive and editorial; the exact three-member leftoverDesign set can remain unchanged.
